whyItMatters: Without nosniff, browsers may MIME-sniff responses and treat untrusted content as an executable type.
actions: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.
Return accurate Content-Type values for every served resource.
Re-run a passive DAST scan to confirm the header is observed.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes nosniff on the target's responses.
